_doc: Where a reader marked the STAND-IN's facial landmarks (Kalén, a Swedish coachman in livery, in an undated glass negative by Ernst Blom (Västmanlands läns museum, Vlm-Blom P 157); not Charles Nelson), in pixels of the crop `crop_px` of the copy named in `scan`. His face is near frontal, turned a little to his left, so his RIGHT ear (the reader's left) is marked; his cap's peak shades the brow. `base_body` fits against Charles Nelson's own body's rest face.
age_note: The record gives no date and no age; he looks to be in his fifties, so 55 is a reading of the picture. The renderer's ageing pair takes the face to Charles Nelson's own 56 at the scene date.
basis: No photograph of Charles Nelson is known. His face's proportions are fitted to a stand-in: Kalén, a Swedish coachman in livery, in an undated glass negative by Ernst Blom (Västmanlands läns museum, Vlm-Blom P 157), a Swedish coachman of middle age. It is not him: what the face shows is that kind of man, not Charles Nelson, so the face is reconstructed.
not_modelled: his own face (no photograph of him is known; this is a stand-in's)
his hair (under the stand-in's cap; the model wears the town's short cut)

stand_in.label: STAND-IN, NOT CHARLES NELSON
stand_in.card_note: No photograph of Charles Nelson is known. This is a stand-in: Kalén, a Swedish coachman photographed in livery by Ernst Blom, a man of about Charles Nelson's age, country and work. The negative is undated and may be later than 1904. His face is the model's guide; it is not Charles Nelson.
